name: current_datetime
description: The current date, time and day of the week where Lancer is (Riverside, California). Call this for anything time-relative -- today, tomorrow, what day is it, what time is it, is it still morning, how long until a date. Lancer's own training data has no idea what day it is, so never answer a date question without calling this.

until.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). When given, also returns how many days away that date is.
